title: The Veil
description: A chapter about quests you cannot see: one that reveals itself a link at a
time, one that stays hidden until you have stumbled onto part of it, one
whose description is withheld until it is done, and a crossroads where the
road you take closes the others for good.
Every hiding flag in the format is written out somewhere in this chapter,
so each one has a file you can read it in -- and a canvas you can watch
